next_step: POC kickoff (hosted) + test-suite for prompt parity; legal to review DPA
notes:
Topline: CloudHaven Tools is a workflow automation SaaS (productivity/tooling) evaluating Redwood as replacement for current LLM provider (primary: OpenAI). They want to start on Redwood Hosted to validate parity and then migrate to Dedicated for predictable throughput and data isolation. Key ask: compatibility layer so minimal SDK/prompt changes, deterministic prompt parity tests, and guardrails for regressions.

Recent quote from Head of ML: "We need parity on outputs for 95% of production prompts; regressions at edge cases OK but must be visible and rollbackable."

Technical notes: currently run mixed workload — 60% chat assistant for end-user workflows, 25% embeddings for semantic search, 15% reranking for recommendation pipeline. Latency targets: p95 chat <= 400ms, embeddings (batch) < 1200ms for 128 vectors, throughput 300 qps steady with spikes to 700 qps during release windows. Cost sensitivity: moderate; willing to trade some cost for consistent latency and predictable billing.

Migration concerns: prompt tokens and function-calling semantics differ between providers; they want a compatibility shim or small wrapper to keep product code unchanged. They're worried about subtle semantic drift (temperature, sampling defaults, tokenization). Require eval harness that runs ~5k golden prompts and flags regressions.

Commercial: interested in 12–24 month reserved capacity once POC passes. Legal has flagged DPA and data residency clauses — need SOC2 + audit logging + KMS. Pricing talks started; AE shared draft pricing deck (linked).

Sales notes (shorthand): demo 2026-02-18 strong; POC scope agreed 2026-03-03 (hosted, 6 weeks, 2 routes: chat + embeddings). SE to provide prompt-parity test harness and baseline results vs OpenAI. Customer prefers Redwood model variants that match performance/quality and an automated fallback to OpenAI during dedicated rollout for safety.
